commentary: While headline benchmarks post fresh nominal highs led by heavyweights, underlying market breadth remains tepid at 41 with the deterministic market gate scored as WEAK. Under Stan Weinstein's stage framework, broad participation is essential to validate index expansion; selective rotation demands stringent defensive discipline. Following William O'Neil's market-direction rules and Mark Minervini's progressive exposure guidelines, capital commitments must remain strictly curtailed. We prioritize leading Stage 2 equities flashing true CANSLIM earnings acceleration and tight VCP structures, while penalizing extended names, low-liquidity debt ETFs, and laggards with decelerating bottom-line performance.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Consolidating near 20-session resistance at 116.92 above key EMAs, but lacks tight VCP volume dry-up. Relative strength remains mediocre.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating profit margin is depressed at ~2.8% alongside a fragile ROE of 2.8% and ROCE near 5.6%. Debt-to-equity is low (0.29), but earnings quality lacks institutional CANSLIM backing.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails on a breakdown below key support at 106.43; exit instantly if the base deteriorates.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Constructive double-bottom formation pressing against the 1,048.30 neckline pivot. All moving averages align upward, accompanied by strong relative strength and RSI at 71.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Triple-digit EPS growth matches CANSLIM standards. Operating margins expanded to 22%, ROE is 9.2%, debt-to-equity is manageable at 0.35, and promoter stake stands stable at 39.7%.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Violates thesis if price drops below double-bottom swing support at 965.77; cut loss immediately.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Classic 20-day breakout clearing 420.42 overhead pivot. Price rides above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with expanding MACD histogram.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Robust lending and financing revenue expansion (+32% YoY) fuels 38% bottom-line growth. ROE holds firm at 11.7% with backing from a 68.8% promoter stake.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Breakout is aborted on a close below 397.78 support; cut loss per SEPA risk-reward rules.

ABGSEC.technical: CRISIL Gilt benchmark debt instrument trading in a tight, non-equity range near 118.12. SEPA trend template and VCP criteria are structurally non-applicable.
ABGSEC.fundamental: Sovereign debt tracking instrument devoid of corporate operating margins, commercial earnings growth, or equity balance-sheet ratios.
ABGSEC.risk: Thesis invalid below 116.63 pivot support; yield spike or duration shocks dictate principal loss.

ABSLBANETF.technical: Clean 20-day breakout to new all-time highs above 64.86, backed by a massive 4.16x volume expansion confirming strong institutional demand.
ABSLBANETF.fundamental: Passive Bank Nifty index vehicle reflecting underlying commercial bank profitability; lacks individual company financial ratios.
ABSLBANETF.risk: Exits on a reversal back into the prior trading range under 62.05 stop level.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: Overnight liquid fund proxy moving in flat cash-equivalent increments. Volume and chart compression do not reflect equity accumulation dynamics.
ABSLLIQUID.fundamental: Cash-management overnight vehicle earning call-money rates; entirely outside CANSLIM fundamental equity criteria.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Thesis fails if price breaks beneath 1004.54 stop level due to liquidity displacement.
